H: 2807.                                                                 24th October, 1935.

Miss M. Homan - M.I. 5.

Dr. Max HODANN.

Reference previous correspondence (P.F.43231/D.S.9.a) and your minute dated 28.9.35.

The attached copies of letters dated 21.10.35. and 23.10.35. are forwarded for your information.

T.B.W.
